def simulate_program(a, n):
    for i in range(1, n):
        x, y = 1, 0
        while True:
            x += a[i - 1]
            y += a[i - 1]
            if x > n:
                break
            x, y = x - a[i - 1], y - a[i - 1]
        print(y if x <= n and x > 0 else -1)
